review.algorithm_assessment: Reduce a good ratio to coprime p/q with p,q <=9. For p<q, all candidates are x=p*k,y=q*k with 1<=k<=floor(n/q), and witnesses are pairs (p*d,q*d) for d<=floor(9/q). A least-significant-digit DP multiplies k by both p and q, retaining exact multiplication carries and which witness digits have appeared. A shared witness absorbs into a good state. The comparison borrow checks k<=floor(n/q) without leading-digit restrictions; padded zeros cannot create a nonzero witness. Flush remaining product carries before checking masks. Distinct reduced ratios do not overlap; symmetry doubles p<q and equal fractions contribute exactly n. All arithmetic counts are modulo 998244353.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
